coverage.evidence: The Federation page sits in the settings.connections nav group (dashboard/src/layouts/dashboard/settingsNavigation.ts:67-71, label Federation in dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json:910). The route needs federation:optin:read (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/settings/federation/route.ts:21), which is seeded at LeadModerator (20) with Editor 30 and Broadcaster 40 above it (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Content/Identity/ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:52-54,481-483). The network block and mass ban switches are Broadcaster-only (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:282,284). GatedSwitch shows an On/Off badge to anyone without the permission (dashboard/src/components/layout/GatedSwitch.vue:44-51). Peer trust is set only by platform admins with IamManage (server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/V1/FederationController.cs:75-76).

An incoming shared ban is placed at once on the channel's own token, with no approval step, and is recorded as a moderation_action (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Moderation/SharedBanService.cs:273-310). A Twitch refusal publishes SharedChatBanNotAppliedEvent, which the action-required inbox reads (SharedBanService.cs:313-354; server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Notifications/Sources/SharedBanNotAppliedSource.cs:46). Untrusted peers are rejected before anything is applied (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Federation/FederationInboundGateway.cs:62-78). SharedChatBanInboundHandler is the only inbound handler, so bans are the only kind of data accepted (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Moderation/Federation/SharedChatBanInboundHandler.cs:31-38), and no outbound federation sender exists. Each switch saves at once (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/settings/federation/FederationView.vue:87-111), and the mass ban and network block switches write Channel flags (server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/V1/ModerationController.cs:2043-2110).

A rule for every trusted server (PeerId null) and a rule for one server are OR-ed together, so removing the one-server rule leaves the general rule in force (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Federation/FederationOptInService.cs:123-131,152-161). Turning Accept off or removing a peer row only flips the row, and nothing unbans (FederationOptInService.cs:73-75,96-98). A network block reaches only opted-in channels at apply time (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Moderation/NetworkBlockService.cs:315-319) and again when the blocked actor chats (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Moderation/NetworkBlockEnforcementService.cs:34-52). A block that is lifted, or whose lift was started, adds no new bans (NetworkBlockEnforcementService.cs:76-79).

Inclusion goes own channel, then attacked, then owner opt-in, then the moderator's own list; an excluded channel is always skipped; only an ordinary live channel is held; and a live channel that does not use the bot waits until it goes offline (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Moderation/MassBan/MassBanChannelPlanner.cs:91-103,191-225). Admins (platform principals) reach opted-in channels (MassBanChannelPlanner.cs:130-146). The chat notice is posted, and if it fails the batch is held until offline (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Moderation/MassBan/MassBanConsentService.cs:343-398). Approve and decline apply to every open held batch (MassBanConsentService.cs:400-437). A held batch runs after approval or once the channel is offline, and a declined batch never runs (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Moderation/MassBan/MassBanExecutor.cs:114-145). !allow and !disallow need level 20 (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Moderation/Builtins/AllowBuiltin.cs:40, DisallowBuiltin.cs:39).

reader_answers.evidence: There are three independent switches: the Shared chat bans Accept (FederationChoiceRow.vue:52-57), Ban here (i18n/en.json:49) and the mass ban Accept (i18n/en.json:41). All start off (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Identity/Persistence/ChannelConfiguration.cs:73-74; FederationOptInService.cs:25-27). Share sends nothing, because no outbound federation path exists, only the inbound gateway and translator.

The page opens for LeadModerator and above (route.ts:21; ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:481). The network block and mass ban switches are Broadcaster-only (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:282,284). A peer must be Trusted (FederationOptInService.cs:113-121), and trust is set by an IamManage admin (FederationController.cs:75-76).

The switch saves immediately (FederationView.vue:104-110). Accepted bans write moderation_action records (SharedBanService.cs:290-308), which ModerationProjectionService.cs:232 reads. Refused bans reach the inbox (SharedBanNotAppliedSource.cs:46). Without the permission a person sees the On/Off badge (GatedSwitch.vue:44-51).

A federated ban is applied with no hold (SharedBanService.cs:273-286). A mass ban on an ordinary live channel is held with a notice and can be declined with !disallow massban (MassBanChannelPlanner.cs:208-225; MassBanConsentService.cs:343-358,400-437). If no one answers it runs once the channel is offline (MassBanExecutor.cs:126-145), and attacked channels are not held (MassBanChannelPlanner.cs:100).
